name: optcatalog_shutdown_core
description: OptCatalog::ShutdownCore frees catalog dynamic storage, clears runtime/global state, destroys thermal glow state, releases the loaded tree, restores default flags, and returns zero.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog/zWeapon source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b1d90 validates freeing per-entry impact FX, kill verb, description, and military-name allocations; destroying impact-node chains; freeing entry/runtime pools; calling Light::DestroyThermalGlowPool and zReader::FreeLoadedTree; clearing OptCatalog globals; restoring fallback/capture flags to one; clearing queued impact and damage-feedback hit counts; and returning zero.

The native shutdown smoke calls OptCatalog::Shutdown, which delegates to ShutdownCore, and verifies catalog table/runtime storage, free-list, world, pending-spawn overrides, fallback/capture flags, queued impact count, and damage-feedback count are reset.
